home.principles.heading: How we work
principle.assumptions.title: Assumptions always visible
principle.assumptions.body: Every number the answer depends on is listed beside it, with a source and a date. Change any of them and the result updates.
principle.conservative.title: Conservative defaults
principle.conservative.body: When a value is uncertain, the default makes the costlier option work harder to win. Monthly savings, for example, are not assumed to earn interest.
principle.realTerms.title: Post-tax and inflation-aware
principle.realTerms.body: Where a decision depends on returns or on money years from now, the tools account for tax on returns and for the time value of money, and say how.
principle.noProducts.title: No product recommendations
principle.noProducts.body: We don’t name or recommend funds, policies, lenders or car models. The tools compare choices; picking a product is up to you.
footer.disclaimer: For education only. Not investment, tax or insurance advice. Decidewise is not registered with SEBI or IRDAI. Check the figures before you act.

carFuel.explanation: Each car’s monthly fuel cost is distance ÷ mileage × fuel price, plus any extra upkeep. The CNG car’s saving adds up month by month, and it breaks even when that running total covers the extra price of the CNG variant. The stricter test also charges interest on the extra price, at your loan rate or what the money could have earned, compounded monthly. Fuel prices rise each year by the rates you set; by default they stay flat.

carFuel.faq.1.q: Why are there two break-even figures?
carFuel.faq.1.a: Without interest, break-even is when the fuel saved equals the extra price. With interest, the extra price also grows at your loan rate, because that money was borrowed or could have earned elsewhere. The second figure comes later, and the verdict uses it.
carFuel.faq.2.q: Where do the fuel prices come from?
carFuel.faq.2.a: Choose your city under Assumptions. Verified city prices fill in automatically, with their source and date in the table above. Prices change daily, so check your local pump.
carFuel.faq.3.q: Does it include resale value, insurance or kit servicing?
carFuel.faq.3.a: Resale value and insurance are not included. Add any extra yearly running cost, such as cylinder testing or kit servicing, under Extra upkeep.
carFuel.faq.4.q: What if I drive less than the example?
carFuel.faq.4.a: The saving shrinks with distance. “What would flip the answer” shows the monthly distance below which petrol wins with your numbers.
